title: Cruzo Cards
tagline: The first multi-chain NFT Marketplace powered with AI tools for digital emotions like greeting cards, stories, crypto gifts, soul bonds, holiday avatars, and party goods in Metaverse. A place where users, creators, and brands can sell, buy, gift, or store their NFTs in Blockchain
description:
Cruzo is the first multi-chain NFT marketplace and Web3 AI-powered platform for digital emotions. Creators, users, collectors, and Brands can meet and interact with digital content released in NFT: greetings, cards, stories, invites, gifts, soul bonds, holiday avatars, and party goods for Metaverse.

By providing utility and ownership with the help of Blockchain technology, we will open a completely new user experience in terms of engagement, loyalty increase, and monetization for Brands, Influencers, Celebrities, Bloggers, and others.

Cruzo as a part of a new Creator's economy will contribute to developing tools and services for the new generation of NFT Creators helping them monetize their artworks and increase their popularity. Thanks to AI-powered tools like generative images and greeting texts, users will have more creative opportunities for sharing emotions in a digital world.

Our mission is to give emotions and happy moments to everyone, as well as advance the mass adaption of NFTs and AI through revolutionary greetings and gifts Web3 platform.
how_its_made:
Frontend: Next.js, SCSS, ethers.js, IPSF 
Backend: Nest.js (REST API), ethers.js, Postgres, Redis, Bull, S3, IPSF 
Blockchain (smart contracts): Solidity 
Indexer: Go Ethereum

FVM+IPSF
Cruzo.Cards uses Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM) and InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) to create a secure and decentralized platform for the creation and exchange of digital greeting cards, etc. The use of FVM ensures transparent and verifiable ownership of cards, while IPFS provides security and resilience through distributed file storage. This benefits users and communities by increasing transparency, security, and resilience of the platform.

Optimism
The integration of Optimism network into Cruzo.Cards offers several advantages, including faster and cheaper transactions, enhanced scalability, and increased security. This integration will allow users to create, buy and sell NFT greeting cards and other digital assets on the Optimism network with ease and efficiency. By leveraging the benefits of Optimism's Layer 2 scaling solution, Cruzo.Cards can provide a seamless and user-friendly experience for its users, while also reducing gas fees and improving overall network performance.

Skroll
Integrating Skroll, a zkEVM-based zkRollup solution, into Cruzo.Cards will bring significant advantages to the platform. By utilizing the Skroll rollup technology, Cruzo.Cards can achieve faster and more efficient transactions on the Ethereum network, while also reducing gas fees for users. The integration will enhance the overall user experience and make it easier for people to create, buy, and sell NFT greeting cards on the platform. Additionally, Skroll's zkEVM technology provides a high level of security and scalability, ensuring that all transactions on Cruzo.Cards are secure and reliable.
